title: Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027"), which for the first time is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator reports to the Training Site Infrastructure Manager and the FIFA Training Site Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Team Services, Team Facilities team and other stakeholders.

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ requires advanced infrastructure and technical services to deliver a seamless tournament experience. The Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator will work alongside the Training Site Infrastructure Manager on the successful delivery and readiness of all FWWC2023 training site infrastructure and overlay requirements throughout the country. The manager will also project manage all Host Country and Local Entity deliverables.

This role will also work with external stakeholders, such as Training Site Authorities, to be part of the Training Site infrastructure team in planning, delivering, and preparing all FWWC2027 training sites in Brazil. The successful candidate will work with the Training Site Authorities and local entity colleagues to ensure the delivery and readiness of the renovations, beautification, upgrade and completion of existing works at training sites. In addition, they will oversee infrastructure and overlay delivery, installation, and dismantling, as well as supply and storage of field of play and training equipment at training sites.

As a member of the Technical Services & Overlay team, you will also work closely with other workstreams, such as Pitch Management, Venue Design, and Dressing and Signage, to ensure the FWWC2027 is delivered to the highest possible standard and, where possible, leaves a lasting legacy.

The successful candidate will ensure all deliverables align with FIFA’s exacting standards while optimizing operational efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction.

Key responsibilities

  • Assist the Training Site Infrastructure Manage in the design and delivery of infrastructure required at training sites for the FWWC2027.
  • Ensure specifications, space and area allocations are developed in compliance with the FIFA training site requirements and fit for purpose.
  • Monitoring the training site renovations, beautifications and upgrade program and overlay deliverables and timelines to ensure all training sites are ready for the participating Teams when they arrive.
  • Assist in the procurement, delivery and installation/storage of field of play and training equipment for all training sites.
  • Participating in regular review meetings to discuss the delivery and readiness of training sites with all external and internal stakeholders.
  • Assist in the handover and hand back of all training sites for the tournament period.
  • Working with Facility Management Services and Cleaning & Waste providers to ensure the training sites are maintained at the appropriate standards during the Teams’ time in the host country.
  • Ensure all equipment and overlay requested are provided and set up by the requirements and location.

Your profile

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 1 year experience in a coordination role in overlay, infrastructure, or technical services in events.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Strong and dynamic interpersonal, leadership and communication skills with an ability to maintain focus in a high-pressure and fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in supplier coordination.
  • Relationships with local suppliers and contractors and well-established networks within the industry would be advantageous.
  • Reliable and committed to meeting quality standards and deadlines, good planning and anticipation, focus on efficient implementation, and follow up after completion.
  • Knowledge of overlay delivery, temporary infrastructure, and technical services for major sporting events.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, MS Project, and other project management tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent negotiation and contract management skills.
  • Driver’s license is a plus.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Na CASSI somos movidos pelo propósito que é o de “Cuidar do participante em todas as fases da sua vida”, ainda que façamos parte de uma equipe de atividade meio ou fim, nosso propósito é único e sempre voltado ao participante da CASSI. Precisamos de pessoas que estejam dispostas a aprender e multiplicar conhecimento, avaliar e trocar ideias sobre o processo com a ótica de que podemos estar em constantes mudanças e melhorias. Caso você precise de algum recurso ou adaptação para participar do processo seletivo ou exercer suas atividades, por favor, informe no campo “Descrição das atividades”. Estamos comprometidos em oferecer um ambiente acessível e acolhedor para todos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Organizar, coordenar, executar e avaliar os serviços de enfermagem sob sua responsabilidade.

  • Verificar a inscrição dos profissionais de Enfermagem da CASSI quanto a suspensão ou cancelamento, e a validade da Carteira de Identidade Profissional (CIP).

  • Observar as Normas Regulamentadoras (NR), as Resoluções de Diretoria Colegiada (RDC), portarias ministeriais e demais atos normativos de órgãos sanitários e de saúde, com a finalidade de mitigar os riscos à saúde da equipe de Enfermagem, do indivíduo, da família ou da coletividade.
  • Participar do processo de seleção de novos profissionais de enfermagem da CASSI, certificando-se que está de acordo com o disposto na Lei n° 7.498/86 e Decreto n° 94.406/87, e demais normas vigentes.
  • Participar da avaliação de desempenho da equipe de Enfermagem de forma periódica, utilizando ferramentas validadas e definidas pela Sede.
  • Promover, estimular e proporcionar, direta ou indiretamente, proposta de política pedagógica que favoreça ao profissional de Enfermagem da CASSI o processo de ensino/aprendizagem com fulcro no aprimoramento, atualização e capacitação de conhecimento técnico, científico e legal.
  • Promover e/ou facilitar junto à CASSI a educação permanente dos profissionais de Enfermagem.
  • Participar no planejamento, execução e avaliação dos programas de saúde da CASSI em que ocorrer a participação de profissionais de Enfermagem.
  • Monitorar e acompanhar o trabalho da equipe de enfermagem, garantindo a integração entre as equipes de enfermagem e a qualidade e segurança da assistência aos participantes CASSI.
  • Colaborar com as atividades da Comissão Interna de Prevenção de Acidentes (CIPA) e de assédio, Comissão de Controle de Infecções Hospitalares (CCIH), Serviço de Educação Continuada e demais comissões instituídas na empresa/instituição.
  • Promover a educação permanente e atualizações da equipe de enfermagem, incentivando a participação em cursos, treinamentos e congressos.
  • Solicitar anualmente, a certidão negativa de débito no conselho profissional de todos os profissionais de Enfermagem.
  • Atuar como responsável técnico da CASSI junto ao Conselho Regional de Enfermagem (COREN), nas unidades onde houver equipe de enfermagem, quando necessário.
  • Assessorar tecnicamente e prestar suporte às áreas da CASSI, quanto a assuntos referentes a conceitos, normas/operacionalização de sistemas relacionados à sua área de atuação, visando consolidar informações e manter a qualidade dos serviços prestados.

  • Participar do planejamento, divulgação, execução e avaliação das atividades de educação em saúde.
  • Manter-se atualizado e assegurar o cumprimento da legislação, dos atos regulatórios e dos princípios éticos que regem o exercício da enfermagem.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer – Tieto Tech Consulting (m/f/d)
description:
Overview

Do you have a strong background in quality assurance, a structured approach to testing, and want to join one of the largest technology companies in the Nordics? Then this is the role for you.

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer who wants to be part of Tieto Tech Consulting . Tieto Tech Consulting works as a true partner, solving clients’ toughest technology challenges and delivering reliable outcomes that drive measurable results. By combining engineering excellence with disciplined quality practices, we support customers developing and operating critical digital platforms.

In this role, you will work in close collaboration with product, engineering, and design teams, ensuring high quality, reliability, and scalability of backend services in a modern cloud-based environment.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with product, engineering, and design teams to refine user stories, ensuring acceptance criteria are clear, complete, and testable.
  • Conduct daily evaluations of the QA swimlane in JIRA for new feature work and collaborate with engineers to execute test cycles.
  • Design, develop, and document comprehensive test plans and test cases for new and existing backend services.
  • Develop and maintain Postman API tests and automated integration test suites targeting backend services and data flows across AWS components (SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, EventBridge).
  • Implement and manage API contract testing to validate integrations and ensure data consistency across internal and external services.
  • Design, execute, and maintain performance, load, and stress tests for critical backend infrastructure to ensure scalability and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to define and test security, access control, and compliance requirements (e.g. HIPAA) for backend services handling sensitive data.
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) to establish continuous quality gates and support safe, frequent deployments.
  • Manage initial release completion, acting as the first quality gate by approving tickets when testing passes or returning them for rework when defects are identified.
  • Collaborate with QA Engineers across squads to ensure a consistent and high-quality experience for both patient- and provider-facing features.

Who We Are Looking For

  • Experienced QA professional with 5+ years of experience in startup or fast-paced environments, combining strong manual testing skills with automated testing capabilities.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience testing AWS-based backend architectures using Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of testing patterns for distributed systems and AWS services such as SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, and EventBridge.
  • Proficiency in a modern programming language such as Python, Java, or TypeScript for writing and maintaining automated test suites.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing automated integration, end-to-end, and component tests.
  • Experience with performance, load, and stress testing applied to backend infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with API contract testing frameworks.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD principles and experience integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines.
  • Familiarity with agile development practices and bug tracking tools (e.g. JIRA, BrowserStack).
  • Strong analytical mindset with a continuous improvement approach.
  • Detail-oriented in test execution and thorough in documentation.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.

Experience in the healthcare domain is considered an advantage.

As a person, you are a team player who takes responsibility for quality, works in a structured and disciplined manner, and communicates clearly. You value accuracy, reliability, and continuous improvement in everything you do.

We offer

We offer professional growth, meaningful projects, an open culture, and a strong work-life balance. You will have the opportunity to work in a growing and future-oriented sector, contributing to high-impact digital solutions. We provide a hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working, and we believe in curiosity and continuous learning as technology evolves.

Location: Asunción, Paraguay (Hybrid)

We perform background checks on all final candidates.

Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

title: Junior Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. Every year we select new junior professionals into the Canonical Kernel Team, to work on the Linux kernel for Ubuntu. If you enjoyed operating systems in your coursework or current role, you are confident in your ability to write high quality C and possibly Rust, and are ready to take the plunge and see how it all works, then this would be a great place to pursue your next career stage. We are a global team working to ship the world's most widely used Linux kernel, across the very latest silicon and cloud, where you can apply and grow your software engineering skills.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Learn from senior mentors to demystify the inner workings of the Linux kernel and how it is distributed
  • Work closely with external silicon, cloud, or hardware manufacturer delivery teams on bleeding-edge platforms
  • Diagnose and resolve issues in the kernel reported by customers, the community, and discovered by your own rigorous testing
  • Take personal responsibility for the delivery of various flavors of the Ubuntu Linux kernel
  • Improve tooling and automation for delivery and test of Ubuntu Linux kernels
  • Submit, review, and apply kernel patches, working with both internal and external upstream maintainers

What we are looking for in you

  • Well-organized and motivated self-starter able to thrive in a remote work environment
  • Professional manner with colleagues, business partners, and the open-source community
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and verbal
  • Programming experience in C and/or Rust
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git
  • Understanding of operating system kernel fundamentals
  • Ability to travel twice a year for company events of up to two weeks length

Nice-to-have skills

  • Interest and experience in Rust
  • Python and Bash scripting ability
  • Prior experience with Ubuntu/Debian/Snap packaging
  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

The role requires an experienced administrator with a strong background in bookkeeping, able to ensure the department\'s fiscal integrity and efficiency, and compliance with university policies. This position works collaboratively across DAR and extensively with colleagues in key financial offices, including the University Budget Office, Procurement and Contracting, and Accounts Payable. Will work with other campus partners as needed. Teamwork, collaboration, and effective communication both across the University and with other development staff, are essential.

Principal Accountabilities

Working closely with the Director of Administration, the Finance Coordinator primarily provides financial administrative support, including bookkeeping, entering requisitions, account reconciliation across the entire department. The role assists with managing and monitoring staff expenses to ensure the timely completion of expense reports. It supports the procurement process, including vendor selection, contract negotiation, and purchase order management, ensuring that all expenditures align with approved budget guidelines and university financial policies and procedures. Responsibilities include assisting with the preparation of financial reports and summaries for review by the Director of Administration and senior leadership, as well as assisting with the development of DAR’s annual budget and audits. The Finance Coordinator may also help to identify opportunities for cost savings and efficiencies within the department’s financial operations.

Core Competencies

  • Excellent administrative, bookkeeping, communication, and time management skills.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy in financial record-keeping and reporting.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret financial data and work with data to inform reporting and task completion.
  • Ability to adhere to standard operating procedures to ensure compliance with financial policies and procedures.
  • Ability to navigate internal processes and structures to problem-solve, take initiative, and contribute to a culture of collaboration, accountability, and excellence.
  • Ability to work collaboratively and independently with purpose and accuracy in a fast-paced environment; and
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment and a high degree of discretion.

Minimum Requirements

title: Payroll Project Manager
description:
Overview

Duration : 9 Months (Fixed-Term Contract), Starting Feb 2026
Reporting to: Director

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly organized and experienced Payroll Project Manager to lead the end-to-end implementation of Client’s new payroll system and service model. You will serve as the primary bridge between Client’s internal stakeholders (HR, Finance, IT), local partner and Neeyamo implementation teams. Your mission is to ensure that the implementation is seamless, compliant with Brazilian labor laws (CLT), and delivered on time and within budget.

Key Responsibilities

  • Project Leadership: Act as the single point of contact for the external payroll provider, ensuring their delivery matches our business requirements and local statutory needs.
  • Implementation Oversight: Manage the full implementation lifecycle: discovery, data migration, parallel runs, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and "Go-Live."
  • Stakeholder Management: Facilitate weekly status meetings with internal leadership and the provider’s project team to track progress and unblock issues.
  • Data Migration & Quality: Lead the cleansing and mapping of legacy data into the new provider’s platform, ensuring 100% accuracy in employee records and year-to-date balances.
  • Process Optimization: Identify opportunities to automate workflows between HRIS and the new payroll platform to reduce manual intervention.
  • Risk Mitigation: Maintain a Risk & Issue Log, proactively identifying bottlenecks that could delay the 10-month timeline.
  • Planning : Compliance: Support future implementation planning, prepare Wave Plans, and ensure adherence to project management frameworks

Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience: 7+ years in Payroll implementations &; project management or HR Project Management, with at least 2 successful large-scale payroll implementations.
  • Local Expertise: Knowledge of Brazilian Labor Law (CLT) and the eSocial framework is
  • Language : Fluency in Portuguese and English (required for global reporting).
  • Technical Savvy : Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, Asana) and advanced Excel. Experience/ knowledge on any Ewaider& ;Co suite of products will be an additional advantage.
  • Communication : Strong negotiation skills to manage vendor performance and expectations.

The Engineer II, Sustainability will be responsible for supporting the activities of the Global Sustainability team related to GHG emissions from marine and offshore vessels/assets as well as activities associated with other sustainability-related projects. These include but are not limited to benchmarking, statistical analysis, and sustainability reporting.

  • Maintain a solid understanding of emerging regulatory framework related to GHG emissions and waste streams
  • Support the department's different projects, services, and other activities.
  • Interact with clients to perform services offered by the Global Sustainability team and identify/resolve problems with technical expertise.

  • Previous experience in business development or sales in a technical and diverse product environment is preferred

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Experience with either marine or offshore applications.
  • Knowledge of GHG regulations, impacts, and technology transition.
  • Experience with programming and advanced use of MS Office.
  • Must be capable of presenting and working with clients
  • Knowledge of related technical disciplines required
  • The ability to identify, analyze and propose solutions to problems (i.e., the competence to demonstrate complex problem-solving skills)
  • Ability to work well with others
  • Excellent communication skills (oral & writt en), enabling effective communication at multiple levels
  • Strong commitment to ethical business practices, in full accordance with relevant corporate policies
  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Obtain a working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Reporting Relationships

title: Staff Front End Engineer (Full time contractor)
description:
Overview

We are looking for a Staff Front-End Engineer in LATAM to join the engineering team! The Staff Front-End Engineer is responsible for setting technical vision for complex, high-traffic user interfaces while delivering exceptional customer experiences. This role provides hands-on leadership across squads, partnering with Product and Design to advance architecture, performance, accessibility, and AI-powered capabilities.

About Nerdy

At Nerdy (NYSE: NRDY) - the company behind Varsity Tutors - we're redrawing the blueprint of learning. Our Live + AI™ platform fuses real-time human expertise with proprietary generative-AI systems, setting a new bar for measurable academic impact at global scale.

We recruit the kind of technologists and operators you'd bet on as solo founders - people who turn ambiguous problems into shipping code, iterate faster than markets move, and compound their advantage with every data point. In an era where great employees can deliver 10-times the leverage of the merely good, we back those who play to win. Fortune favors the bold. Join us.

How we compete

  • AI-Native at every level From the CEO to day-one hires, everyone builds and ships with generative AI. If you're not wielding AI, you're not done.
  • Entrepreneurial velocity Move at founder speed, prototype in hours, and measure in real user outcomes. Slow teams die.
  • Free-market rigor Ideas rise or fall on merit and results - no committees, no politics, no cap on upside.
  • Full-stack ownership You design, build, and run what you ship; accountability is a feature, not a bug.
  • Reward for contribution Pay rises with impact, not years. Outstanding results earn outsized rewards. We evaluate both what you achieve and how you achieve it: living our leadership principles and using AI effectively are formally measured and rewarded.
  • Relentless exploration Push the frontier of generative AI in live learning and - because only the paranoid survive - questioning every legacy assumption along the way.
  • Is Apolitical You stay focused on mission-aligned outcomes, not distractions or unrelated causes.

Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership Serve as the technical point of reference for the squad and broader engineering team, ensuring best practices in frontend architecture, performance optimization, and accessibility standards are upheld.
  • Solution Design Lead the design and architectural discussions for frontend systems, making pivotal decisions on frameworks, state management patterns, component architecture, and design systems.
  • Code Quality Advocate for and ensure the delivery of high-quality, maintainable, and scalable code. Conduct regular code reviews and provide mentorship to team members.
  • Collaboration Work closely with product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements, provide technical insights, and ensure the timely delivery of features.
  • Strategy and Vision Contribute to the engineering department's strategy and vision, bringing innovative ideas to improve our customer-facing experiences.
  • Problem Solving Address complex technical challenges, innovate solutions, and optimize existing systems for scalability and performance.
  • Team Development Mentor and develop team members, helping them to grow in their technical roles and careers.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 10 years of software engineering experience with at least 7 years focused on frontend development, with a proven track record of working on complex, high-traffic web applications.
  • Expert-level proficiency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript and deep experience with React ecosystem.
  • Explicit mentoring of senior-level engineers regularly, leading to results.
  • Significant experience in AWS-based cloud architecture environments.
  • In-depth knowledge of modern software engineering practices, design patterns, and architectures.
  • Experienced with AI-native tools that enhance productivity and speed (Cursor, Make.com, Supabase, Netlify, Claude Code, n8n, Firecrawl, ChatGPT, Grok, Bolt, Vercel, etc).
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated experience in collaborating with multidisciplinary teams.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • A strong owner willing to roll up their sleeves. This role includes coding and reviewing the code of others.
  • Ability to implement customer-facing solutions that solve the customers' true needs with exceptional user experiences.
  • Nerdy is an apolitical company focused solely on helping people learn, and we achieve the most when united in this mission.

Unleash Your Potential at Nerdy

At Nerdy, you'll earn your success through meritocracy and exceptional outcomes. Our benefits reward performance and initiative:

  • Competitive USD Compensation : Enjoy a market-leading rate paid in U.S. dollars.
  • 100% Remote (Home Country Only) : Work from anywhere in your home country—no relocation required, no borders crossed.
  • Flexible Time Off : Our flexible PTO lets you recharge on your own terms and when you need it the most.
  • Local Holiday Pay : We honor your nation's official holidays with paid time off—celebrate what matters to you.
  • Continuous Learning : Get a free, all-inclusive learning membership for you and your household—including 1-on-1 tutoring hours, unlimited on-demand classes, and access to our full suite of learning products and services.
  • Supercharge with AI : Gain exclusive access to cutting-edge AI tools that boost your productivity, making you feel almost super-human (cape not included).
  • Feedback-Rich, Collaborative Culture : Tap into regular training, peer reviews, and a team that treats every team member as a vital collaborator and owner in our success.
  • Make a Global Impact : Your expertise fuels an innovative platform used by learners around the world—be part of something transformative.

The Bottom Line

If you're driven by impact, energized by ownership, and excited to help shape what's next, you'll thrive here. We move fast, think big, and reward those who deliver. This isn't a traditional corporate environment - it's a place to do the most meaningful work of your career.

Quem Somos?

Você sabia que somos a construtora de maior valorização na bolsa de valores em 2025?

Conheça as nossas etapas do processo seletivo:

Ah... pessoas com deficiências são super bem-vindas viu?

Um estudo recente do LinkedIn indicou que mulheres são menos propensas a se candidatarem a vagas se não acreditarem que preenchem 100% das qualificações. title: Python/Django Software Engineer
description:
Overview

WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is a profitable digital media company that reaches over 30M+ monthly visitors through brands such as FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology. Headquartered in South Florida with a remote-first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high-growth, high-performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

WHY JOIN US? At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers.

Responsibilities

  • Your role: Develop, deliver, document and support robust and stable backend application features, third-party integrations and infrastructure across a breadth of services and environments.
  • Outcomes (Performance Expectations):
    • Backend Application Features & Third-Party Integrations
      • Support the development and implementation of backend features and integrations across both legacy and new systems.
      • Collaborate with senior engineers and stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver solutions aligned with business needs.
      • Contribute to feasibility discussions and support early-stage prototyping with guidance from peers.
    • Service Reliability & Code Execution
      • Implement backend functionality with attention to performance, readability, and maintainability.
      • Follow team patterns and contribute to test coverage, including basic post-deployment and load testing scripts.
      • Escalate reliability or performance concerns and partner with senior engineers to resolve them.
    • Monitoring & Issue Resolution
      • Help maintain and improve application monitoring by setting up or adjusting alerts, dashboards, or logs.
      • Participate in debugging and resolving production issues, with support from senior team members.
      • Document fixes and share learnings to strengthen team awareness and incident response.
    • Infrastructure & Deployment Support
      • Support infrastructure tasks using established tools (e.g., Terraform, ECS, Lambda) under guidance.
      • Assist in maintaining CI/CD pipelines and participate in identifying workflow improvements.
    • Code Quality & Collaboration
      • Write maintainable, testable code using frameworks like Django and testing tools such as Pytest.
      • Engage in code reviews with a learning mindset and contribute to a culture of quality and shared ownership.
      • Pair with teammates to troubleshoot issues and improve knowledge of system architecture.
    • Product Awareness & Team Contribution
      • Build awareness of how backend systems connect to product goals and customer outcomes.
      • Share observations that could improve team workflows, code quality, or product performance.
      • Seek clarity on priorities and outcomes to ensure engineering effort supports business value.
  • Competencies
    • Collaborative: Open to feedback, communicates clearly across functions, and adds value through shared knowledge (especially during pull request reviews).
    • Curious & Proactive: Suggests improvements in tooling, deployment, or infrastructure and thinks beyond assigned tasks.
    • Detail-Oriented: Writes maintainable, testable code with a strong grasp of debugging principles and Python design patterns.
    • Execution-Driven: Manages time effectively, prioritizes impact, and consistently meets engineering goals without micromanagement.
    • Growth Mindset: Seeks to understand LP’s products and business context to make informed backend decisions and support data-driven goals.
  • Nice to Haves
    • Track record of backend engineering support for Content Management Systems (CMS) preferred
    • Experience with NextJS systems

Qualifications

  • EXPERIENCE: 3+ years of professional development experience using Python and deploying backend systems using Python frameworks like Django or FastAPI.
  • Must Have: Experience with containerized Python/Django (or FastAPI) services, including deployment on AWS.
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting production bugs in systems with limited QA support.
  • Strong grasp of SQL databases, CI/CD (especially CircleCI), containerized solutions, and infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred).
  • Comfortable contributing ideas, giving peer feedback via pull requests, and driving technical improvements autonomously.

Additional Details

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

Since day one, we’re committed to having a diverse, inclusive team and culture. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity company. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Software Engineer ID45371
description:
Overview

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

About the Role

Join our ambitious team as a Senior Software Engineer specializing in Data Engineering to develop cutting-edge trade surveillance technology, protecting investors and ensuring market integrity. You will have a profound impact by designing and scaling robust, highly available data pipelines and microservices, tackling complex data challenges using modern tools. This unique opportunity offers significant influence and professional growth in a dynamic, collaborative environment that values accountability and a self-starter attitude.

What You Will Do

  • Design and develop the data’s team micro services – Java services running on K8S;
  • Scale our data pipeline to support the processing of billions of events in both low-latency real-time and T+1 batch using advanced technologies like Clickhouse, Spark, and Kafka;
  • Tackle data duplication, velocity, schema adherence (and schema versioning), high availability, data governance, and more;
  • Develop and maintain our data pipeline written mostly in Java and running on K8S in a micro-service architecture;
  • Plan and communicate integrations with other teams that consume the data and use it for insights creation;
  • Ongoing improvement of the way data is stored and served. Improve queries and data formats to make sure the data is optimized for consumption by a variety of clients;
  • Query optimizations in our data warehouses, ensuring data completeness and reliability at scale.

MUST HAVES

  • BSc. in Computer Sciences from a top university, or equivalent;
  • Strong background as a software engineer with at least 3+ years experience with Java ;
  • Experience in data engineering and data pipeline development;
  • Proven experience with relational and non-relational DBs. Expert. Proficient in SQL and query optimizations – preferably in clickhouse;
  • Experience with monitoring systems (either Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix, Datadog);
  • Experience in object-oriented development. Should have strong software engineering foundations;
  • Curiosity, ability to work independently and proactively identify solutions;
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in a remote environment;
  • Upper-intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience working in low-latency, real-time systems processing billions of events a day;
  • Experience with data-engineering cloud technologies as Apache Airflow, K8S, Clickhouse, Snowflake, Redis, Spark, Caching technologies and/or Kafka.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
  • A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solution development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
  • Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

description:
GoHigh Level Specialist

Company: OutfitMD

Department: Operations / Technology

Reports To: CEO & Leadership Team

Role Overview

The GoHigh Level Specialist is responsible for owning, managing, and optimizing the entire backend technology and automation infrastructure for OutfitMD. This role serves as the internal technical authority for CRM systems, workflows, automations, integrations, and platform performance.

This position ensures OutfitMD has full internal control, visibility, and scalability of its systems. The role is highly technical, execution-focused, and critical to the company’s ability to scale efficiently By maintaining strong internal ownership of platform logic and automation, this role enables seamless operations across Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing ensuring systems evolve alongside the business and can reliably support increased volume, complexity, and long-term expansion.

Primary Objectives

  • Own and manage OutfitMD’s CRM and automation ecosystem
  • Build, maintain, and optimize GHL workflows and automations
  • Eliminate dependency on external GHL vendors
  • Ensure system stability, scalability, and performance
  • Support Implementation, Client Success, and Sales through reliable systems

Core Responsibilities

CRM & Automation Ownership

  • Serve as the primary internal expert for GoHighLevel
  • Build and maintain workflows, automations, triggers, and pipelines
  • Configure forms, calendars, intake processes, and communication logic
  • Manage integrations with third-party tools (SMS, email, payment processors, etc.)
  • Maintain clean data structures, tagging, and segmentation

Implementation & Technical Support

  • Support Implementation Support Specialists with backend builds
  • Execute technical setup for new client portals
  • Troubleshoot automation failures, bugs, and system issues
  • Test and QA systems before client launch

System Optimization & Scaling

  • Identify inefficiencies, redundancies, and automation gaps
  • Optimize workflows for speed, accuracy, and scalability
  • Prepare systems to support increased client volume
  • Document technical SOPs and system logic

Security, Compliance & Reliability

  • Ensure systems follow best practices for data handling and access control
  • Manage user permissions and access levels
  • Monitor system uptime and automation health

Internal Collaboration

  • Work closely with Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing
  • Translate business needs into technical solutions
  • Provide leadership with technical insight and recommendations

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Automation reliability and uptime
  • Reduction in system errors or failures
  • Time to resolve technical issues
  • Successful internalization of GHL management
  • System scalability and performance metrics

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Advanced experience with GoHighLevel CRM
  • Advanced English
  • Strong understanding of automation logic and workflows
  • Experience with CRM architecture, pipelines, and data structure
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues independently
  • Strong documentation and organizational skillsAbility to communicate technical concepts to non-technical teams

Preferred

  • Experience replacing or auditing third-party CRM vendors
  • Background in SaaS, automation, or technical operations
  • Familiarity with HIPAA-aware systems (non-clinical)

Why this role matters at outfitmd

The GoHighLevel Specialist ensures our marketing and sales systems run efficiently and produce measurable results. This role is responsible for setting up and optimizing automations, funnels, and CRM workflows so every lead is properly captured, followed up with, and moved through the sales process without manual effort.

By translating business goals into scalable systems, the GoHighLevel Specialist reduces lead loss, improves conversion rates, and supports sustainable growth. This role turns GoHighLevel into a reliable, revenue-driving platform rather than just another software tool.

Descrição da vaga

A Supergasbras é uma empresa do grupo holandês SHV Energy, líder mundial na distribuição de Gás liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP), com mais de 100 anos de experiência. Nosso negócio é levar energia limpa e eficiente para milhões de brasileiros, seja nas suas casas, comércios, indústrias ou agronegócio. Os mais de 76 anos de atuação no Brasil nos posiciona como uma das principais distribuidoras nacionais de GLP - comercializamos cerca de 1,5 milhão de toneladas do produto por ano com aproximadamente 20% de participação de mercado.

Desenvolvemos uma série de projetos com foco em transformação digital, experiência do cliente, inovação e desenvolvimento sustentável do negócio. Nossa estratégia é conseguir através da confiança e integridade, ser a melhor empresa de Energia do Brasil para nossos clientes, parceiros, colaboradores e acionistas, com responsabilidade socioambiental.

Diversidade e inclusão é uma prioridade de negócios para a Supergasbras. Valorizamos e acreditamos no desenvolvimento de pessoas, tanto no contexto profissional como pessoal, tendo como estratégia a equidade de gênero, inclusão de pessoas com deficiência, respeito a todas as orientações sexuais e luta contra a discriminação racial nas diferentes camadas da sociedade.

Ser diverso é ser Super!

Responsabilidades do Cargo

Objetivo do Cargo

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Tributário(a) Pleno com perfil Tech , para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, inovador e em processo contínuo de transformação digital da área fiscal.

Esta é uma vaga afirmativa para pessoas com deficiência (PCD) — valorizamos diversidade, inclusão e diferentes formas de pensar.

  • Monitorar alterações na legislação tributária e avaliar impactos nos processos internos.
  • Prestar atendimento a fiscalizações e auditorias.
  • Acompanhar e compreender os impactos da Reforma Tributária nos processos e obrigações fiscais em geral.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência na área tributária, com foco em tributos indiretos (ICMS, ISS, IPI, PIS e COFINS) e conhecimento em NFe (xml e regras de validação).
  • Ferramentas:
  • Familiaridade com sistemas ERP, preferencialmente SAP;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office (Excel, Word e PowerPoint).
  • Atualização contínua por meio de cursos, seminários, treinamentos e estudos autônomos voltados à área tributária.

Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Conhecimento em Power BI, VBA, Python, SQL ou IA aplicada ao fiscal.
  • Participação em projetos de atualização de Nota Técnica (NT NF-e).
  • Familiaridade com sistemas fiscais (Comply, Mastersaf, PWSAT, Tax One).
  • Inglês (desejável).

Somos uma empresa que valoriza as pessoas e tudo o que elas representam: a energia das ideias, da contribuição, da parceria e da colaboração.

Por isso, nos dedicamos a construir um ambiente de trabalho propício ao desenvolvimento humano e profissional dos nossos colaboradores, sempre incentivando a interação, a participação ativa e o crescimento. title: Venue Design Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Venue Design Manager reports to FIFA27 Head of Infrastructure & Technical Services and FIFA Senior Venue Design Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders.

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ requires venue design of as a key central delivery to fully integrate and visually represent all operations, legacy information and complementary structures required for the tournament. The Venue Design Manager is responsible for leading and implementing the venue design from block planning through to final design across a cluster of official FIFA stadiums and venues.

Role to transition into onsite Venue Overlay Manager during final Event.

Key responsibilities

Raw Data Management

  • Reception, validation and conversion of raw data into clean base CADs

Application of FIFA Drawing Standards:

  • Drawing updates according to FIFA standards and templates (layers, colour codes, line styles, annotation, legends, layouts, naming conventions etc.)

Drawing Updates:

  • Integration of operational content (space allocation, perimeters, flow data, capacities, space tags), legacy information (base infrastructure, legacy usage/annotation/signage) and complementary structures (fences, commodities, FF&E layouts etc.) as required.

Application of BIM 360 workflows:

  • Management and interaction of central database for drawing development, communication, change requests and publications.

Implementation of Space Requirements:

  • Application of requirements according to FIFA Event Platform (EP) and venue limitations.

Drawing Publications:

  • Delivery of drawings sets according to inspections and project timelines (site plans, levels, seating maps, pitch plans, catwalks, sections, detailed layouts etc.)

Ongoing Collaboration:

  • Continuous collaboration and support for Venue Management and FIFA Functional Areas.
  • Collaborate with the Technical Services and Overlay teams, Functional Areas, stadium authorities, and other stakeholders to define, optimize and validate solutions, ensuring technical requirements are accurately reflected in designs and BoQs.

Your profile

  • Degree in architecture, engineering, urban planning or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience managing multi-venue overlay projects, from design to delivery, preferably for major sporting events (e.g., FIFA, Olympic Games).
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, Adobe Creative Cloud and Microsoft Office tools.
  • Strong technical knowledge in temporary infrastructure and spatial planning.
  • Excellent organisational, coordination, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent drawing skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to work under pressure, manage competing priorities, and deliver to tight deadlines.
  • Knowledge of local construction regulations and permitting processes in host country (desirable).
    Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assist in maintaining sufficient stock of parts and materials for rig operations;

  • Responsible for budgetary control of department;
  • Mentor, develop and train crew members to ensure they are competent to work in their current job positions and where appropriate coached and prepared for the next position;
  • Effectively use all safety and environmental tools employed by Seadrill (5-point check, STAR cards, PTW etc.);

SAFETY AT SEADRILL

Our goal is to ensure that ‘nobody gets hurt' whilst performing their job. Everyone at Seadrill has a part to play in meeting our safety commitment. Through strong leadership and personal responsibility from all employees, we take a systematic approach to identifying, managing and preventing the hazards involved in our day to day operations. Nothing is more important to us than the health, safety and security of our workforce and the communities in which we operate and behaving responsibly towards our shared environment. We are vigilant, disciplined and always looking out for one another. We have developed and embedded a strong safety culture onshore and offshore, fostered by all employees, who each have a personal responsibility and the authority to put an immediate stop to the job if they believe it to be unsafe. Everyone at Seadrill is accountable for helping to build this culture of care. This includes:

  • Compliance with the Seadrill Code of Conduct and Fight Against Corruption.
  • Compliance with applicable internal and external governing requirements.
  • Non-compliances are promptly acted on and reported to the direct supervisor.

title: Reliability & Rotating Equipment Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocatio[...]
description:
Job Overview

This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat family relocation package.

We are seeking a reliability/rotating equipment engineer to join the North Ghawar Maintenance Division (NGMD) / Reliability Unit (RU) of North Ghawar Producing Department (NGPD).

The RU's scope includes condition-based maintenance, reliability-centered maintenance, and failure analysis to identify and mitigate potential equipment failures. By leveraging these services, the RU aims to optimize rotating equipment reliability, reduce maintenance costs, and improve overall asset efficiency.

Your primary role is to provide proactive maintenance support, including rotating equipment reliability, Predictive Maintenance (PDM) services such as vibration analysis and oil analysis, and overseeing rotating equipment overhaul activities to ensure optimal equipment performance and minimize downtime.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate, you will be required to perform the following:

  • Develop and implement comprehensive reliability and maintenance strategies for rotating equipment, including pumps, compressors, Dry Gas Seal Systems, and gearboxes.
  • Oversee and perform Product Data Management (PDM) services, such as vibration analysis and oil analysis, to identify potential equipment failures and recommend corrective actions.
  • Develop and implement condition-based maintenance programs to optimize equipment performance and minimize downtime.
  • Develop and implement reliability-centered maintenance programs to identify and prioritize maintenance activities based on equipment reliability and criticality.
  • Perform failure analysis on equipment to identify root causes of failures and recommend corrective actions to prevent repeat failures.
  • Perform technical evaluations of new equipment to ensure compliance with industry standards and codes, and to identify potential reliability and maintenance issues.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards and codes, such as American Petroleum Institute (API), American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME), and American Society for Testing and Materials ASTM, for rotating equipment and reliability engineering.
  • Prepare technical reports and presentations to communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders, including management and operations teams.
  • Perform oil analysis and other predictive maintenance tests to identify potential equipment problems and recommend corrective actions.
  • Perform diagnostics on rotating equipment, including pumps, compressors, and gearboxes, to identify potential problems and recommend corrective actions.
  • Maintain Reliability Unit KPIs such as, Maintenance cost reduction, Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF), Mean Time To Repair (MTTR)

As the successful candidate, you will have:

  • The successful candidate should hold a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized and approved program. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • You will have a minimum of 15 years-experience in Reliability / rotating equipment engineering.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of Reliability, including rotating equipment reliability, Predictive Maintenance (PDM) services, and condition-based maintenance.
  • Familiarity with rotating equipment diagnostics such as vibration analysis, oil analysis, and non-destructive testing methods.8
  • Hold vibration analyst certificate Cat-III
  • Understanding of industry standards and codes related to reliability, such as API, ASME, and ASTM.
  • Practical experience in reliability engineering or a related field, preferably in the oil and gas industry.
  • Effective analytical and communication skills to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, prepare technical reports, and present findings to stakeholders.
  • Awareness of the latest advancements in reliability science and technologies through professional development courses, certifications, workshops, conferences, and memberships in relevant industry organizations.
  • Knowledge of rotating equipment, including pumps, compressors, Dry Gas Seal Systems, and gearboxes.
  • Experience with Predictive Maintenance (PDM) services, such as vibration analysis and oil analysis.
  • Familiarity with condition-based maintenance, reliability-centered maintenance, and failure analysis.
  • Ability to perform and help with technical evaluations of new equipment.

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

title: Mechanic V
description:
Overview

Perform, under supervision, preventive and corrective maintenance services on aircraft, in accordance with the procedures provided for in the Brazilian aeronautical legislation, manufacturers' manuals and technical manuals, aiming at the perfect functioning of the fleet.

Main Responsibilities

  • Perform, under supervision, scheduled and occasional periodic maintenance, repairs and inspections, according to the Daily Maintenance Report (RDM), in accordance with the Service Order (OS), Maintenance Form and manufacturer's manual, aiming at compliance with the Aircraft Maintenance Program and ensuring that they are in airworthy condition.
  • Carry out, under supervision, pre-flight inspection procedures, verifying the items contained in the aircraft's Pre-flight Inspection Sheet, to ensure airworthiness conditions before the first flight of the day, in accordance with the requirements of the manufacturer's manual.
  • Perform, under supervision, inspection procedures between flights, checking the items in the Pre-flight Inspection Form and visually inspecting the main and tail rotors, to ensure airworthiness conditions before the next flight, in accordance with the determinations of the company's technical manuals.
  • Carry out, under supervision, daily inspection procedures, inspecting more comprehensively items that appear in the aircraft's Maintenance Sheet, to meet the requirements of the manufacturer's manual after the last flight of the day.
  • Perform, under supervision, scheduled inspection procedures on the aircraft, according to the system database (RAMCO), to ensure airworthiness and that all inspections are carried out.
  • Keep the work area clean and organized, within the expected standards, in order to ensure a pleasant environment without risk of accidents.
  • Perform, under supervision, other activities inherent to their area of expertise.

Quer fazer parte de uma das maiores redes de clínicas odontológicas do Brasil? Há mais de 39 anos no mercado, o Grupo Clínicas Inteligentes é uma das maiores redes de clínicas odontológicas. Presente em mais de 20 estados, o nosso grupo é formado por 4 marcas que contam com a colaboração de 2100 colaboradores e um dos melhores corpos clínicos do Brasil. Com conceito de clínica popular, somos determinados a garantir o pronto atendimento em ambientes seguros, confortáveis e climatizados por um valor justo e acessível. Nós do grupo Clínicas Inteligentes somos apaixonados pelo que fazemos. Acreditamos que o atendimento humanizado contagia e motiva a todos que se relacionam conosco.

O Grupo Clínicas Inteligentes informa que sua participação em nossos processos seletivos é gratuita e nenhum fornecedor ou terceiro está autorizado a cobrar valores para candidatura à vaga, treinamento, material didático ou qualquer outra despesa relacionada.

  • Auxiliar o profissional, no atendimento aos pacientes, em tarefas como segurar o sugador de saliva, fazer o afastamento lingual e alcançar materiais e instrumentos odontológicos.
  • Fazer a manipulação de material provisório e definitivo usado para restauração dentária.
  • Preparar o material anestésico, de sutura, polimento, bem como proceder à troca de brocas.
  • Separar o material e instrumentos clínicos em bandejas para utilização pelo profissional, zelar pela boa manutenção de equipamentos e peças, preparar, acondicionar e esterilizar materiais e equipamentos utilizados.
  • Colaborar com a limpeza e organização do local de trabalho (consultórios, sala de esterilização e infecção).

  • Realização de procedimentos básicos junto aos pacientes (remoção de sutura, higiene oral, tomadas radiográficas) sempre com supervisão do Dentista.
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas ao cargo e/ou determinadas pelo superior.

title: Pessoa Analista de Comunicação Corporativa Pleno
description:
Job description

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Analista de Comunicação Corporativa. Este papel é fundamental para atender às necessidades de um dos principais players do mercado brasileiro de petróleo.

O desafio envolve planejar, desenvolver e monitorar a comunicação de uma gerência do setor de Exploração e Produção de O&G, garantindo qualidade, clareza e alinhamento estratégico em todas as comunicações da gerência. Você será responsável por criar o plano de comunicação, implementar métricas que demonstrem a efetividade das ações e liderar iniciativas que assegurem que as mensagens estejam conectadas aos objetivos e metas da área, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo, transparente e de alto engajamento.

Main responsibilities

Principais atividades:

  • Desenvolver e implementar o plano de comunicação da área, alinhado aos objetivos estratégicos;
  • Realizar diagnósticos de percepção do público e propor ações de melhoria baseadas em técnicas como ADKAR ou outras;
  • Desenvolvimento de formas de comunicação (páginas web, comunicados em e-mail, postagem em redes sociais, notícias, vídeos) que comuniquem as transformações no processo de Operação & Manutenção;
  • Propor materiais institucionais que capturem a atenção do público‑alvo com divulgação em diferentes meios e alinhados às diretrizes da área de Comunicação Empresarial da Petrobras;
  • Orientar e direcionar a elaboração de narrativas para o desenvolvimento de peças de comunicação internas demandadas pelas áreas e aplicáveis a diferentes objetivos e públicos-alvo e auxiliar na confecção e/ou revisão de textos, de modo a tornar a comunicação clara, objetiva, estratégica, atrativa e efetiva em relação ao objetivo estabelecido;
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento de relatórios gerenciais ou técnicos, com foco no leiaute e revisão de texto;
  • Planejamento e produção de conteúdo, elaboração de campanhas de caráter informativo e/ou pedagógico, organização de eventos, mensuração de resultados de postagens em mídias sociais internas;
  • Planejamento de campanhas, ações, estratégias, fluxos de trabalho, alcance de resultados e outros, que visem divulgar e perenizar novas soluções tecnológicas;
  • Desenvolver estratégias eficazes de comunicação corporativa (forma e conteúdo), direcionadas para diferentes públicos, da Alta Administração às frentes operacionais;
  • Elaboração de plano de ação de relacionamento para tratamento dos pontos críticos identificados no diagnóstico de percepção, sugerindo soluções de gestão do relacionamento a serem implementadas para cada público e para cada canal de relacionamento.
  • Apoio técnico para atuar na gestão, monitoramento e implantação das soluções e ações de relacionamento com o público de interesse, na análise de dados de pesquisas junto ao público de interesse, na implantação das soluções e ações do plano de relacionamento, no tratamento dos pontos críticos identificados e apresentados no diagnóstico de percepção e nas soluções de gestão do relacionamento a serem implementadas para cada público e para cada canal de relacionamento.
  • Desenvolver e/ou dar suporte à elaboração de planos de comunicação e/ou relacionamento, com foco em seus principais elementos e conteúdos, como diagnósticos, objetivos, estratégias, planos de ação, e instrumentos de avaliação.O serviço também engloba a coleta, análise, tratamento, registro, sistematização de informações e desenvolvimento e/ou aplicação de metodologias de planejamento.
  • Capturar oportunidades de desenvolvimento ou fortalecimento das ações de comunicação para divulgação das ações e resultados das atividades que são escopo de atuação da área.

Requirements and skills

Formação:

  • Formação em Comunicação Social, Relações Públicas, Jornalismo, Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimentos necessários:

  • Experiência em redação e edição, web design e produção de conteúdo, redes sociais e plataformas de gestão de conteúdo;
  • Conhecimento avançado de ferramentas de comunicação digital;
  • Conhecimento avançado de softwares de edição de mídia;
  • Domínio de ferramentas do pacote MS Office, especialmente as voltadas para comunicação;
  • Domínio da Língua Portuguesa (oral e escrita);
  • Inglês avançado (ideal) ou intermediário (aceitável) - conversação e escrita;
  • Forte habilidade de comunicação interpessoal e influência em diferentes níveis organizacionais;
  • Capacidade de autogerenciamento, com foco em resultados e gestão de prioridades;
  • Organização e atenção a detalhes, com habilidade para gerenciar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente;
  • Proatividade e senso crítico para identificar e solucionar desafios de comunicação;

Diferenciais

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Comunicação Empresarial / Corporativa / Estratégica, ou Gestão de Mudanças Organizacionais.
  • Experiência no setor de óleo e gás.
  • Certificações relacionadas à área de Comunicação.

Informações adicionais:

  • Estamos buscando preferencialmente profissionais que estejam no RJ.

Additional information

CONHEÇA NOSSOS BENEFÍCIOS

Alguns dos nossos benefícios são flexíveis para que você possa distribuí-los de acordo com suas necessidades, interesses e momento de vida. São eles:

  • All Points (Programa de pontos para passagens áreas e hospedagens);
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Convênio para Pet;
  • Mobilidade (incluindo opção de combustível e Uber, 99);
  • Reembolso Flex (óculos, vacinas, educação, shows e outros);
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação.

Outros benefícios:

  • Birthday off;
  • Gympass;
  • Consultoria financeira e empréstimo facilitado;
  • Clube Alelo com diversos descontos em lojas e farmácias;
  • Licença Maternidade de 180 dias;
  • Licença Paternidade de 30 dias;
  • Auxílio creche no primeiro ano do bebê;
  • Vale Transporte conforme a demanda do projeto ou área;
  • Programa de bônus anual;
  • Comissionamento por indicação de novos clientes.

PROGRAMAS DE DESENVOLVIMENTO

Um dos pontos fortes de ser Biper é que ousamos em pensar como empreendedores e moldamos nosso futuro com nossa capacidade de pensar minuciosamente e agir com três passos à frente, pavimentando o caminho para o futuro que nossos clientes querem viver.

E para isso, precisamos estar constantemente aprendendo e reaprendendo, somos #LifeLongLearning.

Na BIP tem programas consolidados a nível Global e nacional para que você tenha uma jornada de desenvolvimento, crescimento e liberdade para você conquistar o que sonha. Aqui você é o protagonista da sua carreira!

Vamos juntos nessa? Confere os principais programas que a BIP pode te oferecer para você chegar aonde deseja:

  • Um centro de CAPACITAÇÃO e FORMAÇÃO Global com os conteúdos e cursos mais atualizados do mercado;
  • Flex Time - um momento da sua semana dedicado para o seu desenvolvimento;
  • Programas de mentoria com Líderes referências em sua atuação;
  • Avaliação de Desempenho semestral;
  • Cultura de Feedback e 1:1 recorrentes com sua liderança e time;
  • Acompanhamento de um Plano de Desenvolvimento personalizado pra você e com seus objetivos;
  • Darwin - Programa global de formação de jovens talentos, para desenvolver soft e hard skills;
  • Grounding –Um programa Global de formação para os profissionais recém contratados em todo o mundo que estão no começo da carreira de consultoria;
  • Induction - Onboarding Internacional conduzido por Heads de RH e negócio para os novos entrantes da Bip de todos os países para promover nossa cultura,valores, proposito e apresentar nossos programas de iniciativa Global.
  • Spinnaker: Treinamento focado em aprimorar habilidades estratégicas de Gerentes e Gerentes Seniores, apoiando e facilitando o desenvolvimento de negócios dentro de um ecossistema complexo.

description:
A Creamy Skincare faz parte do grupo Skelt Beauty Brands e oferece produtos que se destacam pela sua qualidade excepcional e exclusividade. Na Creamy, somos apaixonados por transformar a rotina de cuidados com a pele em um momento especial. Oferecemos produtos “creamy de la creamy” – ou seja, os melhores dos melhores! Se você ama o mundo da beleza e quer se juntar a um time que valoriza qualidade e trabalho em equipe, continue lendo!

Sua missão:

Como Vendedor(a) no nosso quiosque Creamy, você será o rosto da nossa marca! Sua missão é criar conexões genuínas com nossos clientes, oferecendo um atendimento impecável e personalizado. Você vai adorar trabalhar com nossos produtos, que se vendem sozinhos, mas você estará lá para ajudar a tornar cada compra uma experiência inesquecível.

Quais serão suas responsabilidades?

  • Realizar o atendimento e proporcionar uma experiência encantadora aos nossos clientes por meio de uma abordagem acolhedora, profissional e atenta às suas necessidades;
  • Estabelecer e cultivar relacionamentos duradouros com os clientes, garantindo uma experiência positiva tanto no processo de venda quanto no acompanhamento pós-venda, reforçando a confiança e a fidelidade à marca;
  • Abordar novos clientes, enquanto fortalece e mantém uma base de clientes sólida, garantindo o crescimento sustentável e o desenvolvimento de relacionamentos de longo prazo;
  • Monitorar de acordo com a autorização do cliente e de forma regular as preferências dos mesmos, garantindo que suas necessidades e expectativas sejam continuamente atendidas e ajustando estratégias conforme necessário;
  • Manter-se constantemente atualizado(a) sobre nossos produtos, incluindo as últimas tendências, princípios ativos, lançamentos e inovações da marca, para garantir um atendimento especializado e informado;
  • Oferecer um atendimento personalizado, esclarecendo dúvidas e apresentando com entusiasmo os diferenciais de nossos produtos excepcionais;
  • Seguir rigorosamente as normas de vestimenta e apresentação pessoal estabelecidas nas diretrizes da empresa, garantindo uma imagem profissional e alinhada à identidade corporativa;
  • Fomentar uma comunicação clara e eficaz com a gestão, a equipe e os clientes, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e assegurando um atendimento de alta qualidade;
  • Assegurar a apresentação e limpeza do quiosque, mantendo um ambiente agradável e convidativo para os clientes;
  • Monitorar continuamente os próprios resultados e praticar a autogestão para alcançar as metas estabelecidas, sempre sob a orientação da liderança;
  • Cooperar para resolução de conflitos de forma eficaz, promovendo um ambiente harmonioso e colaborativo;
  • Adaptar-se rapidamente às mudanças, demonstrando flexibilidade e resiliência diante de novos desafios;
  • Responsável pela preparação e reposição de produtos, controle eficiente de estoque e gestão completa de abertura e fechamento de caixa;
  • Executar atividades acima correlatas

Qualificações necessárias:

  • Ensino Médio completo;
  • Experiência prévia em vendas, especialmente em quiosques ou lojas de shopping, é um plus!
  • Habilidade para criar conexões e oferecer um atendimento excepcional.
  • Vontade de aprender e se apaixonar pelos produtos “creamy de la creamy”.
  • Boa comunicação e atitude positiva.

description:
Overview

Perform, under supervision, preventive and corrective maintenance services on aircraft, in accordance with the procedures provided for in the Brazilian aeronautical legislation, manufacturers' manuals and technical manuals, aiming at the perfect functioning of the fleet.

Main Responsibilities

  • Perform, under supervision, scheduled and occasional periodic maintenance, repairs and inspections, according to the Daily Maintenance Report (RDM), in accordance with the Service Order (OS), Maintenance Form and manufacturer's manual, aiming at compliance with the Aircraft Maintenance Program and ensuring that they are in airworthy condition.
  • Carry out, under supervision, pre-flight inspection procedures, verifying the items contained in the aircraft's Pre-flight Inspection Sheet, to ensure airworthiness conditions before the first flight of the day, in accordance with the requirements of the manufacturer's manual.
  • Perform, under supervision, inspection procedures between flights, checking the items in the Pre-flight Inspection Form and visually inspecting the main and tail rotors, to ensure airworthiness conditions before the next flight, in accordance with the determinations of the company's technical manuals.
  • Carry out, under supervision, daily inspection procedures, inspecting more comprehensively items that appear in the aircraft's Maintenance Sheet, to meet the requirements of the manufacturer's manual after the last flight of the day.
  • Perform, under supervision, scheduled inspection procedures on the aircraft, according to the system database (RAMCO), to ensure airworthiness and that all inspections are carried out.
  • Keep the work area clean and organized, within the expected standards, in order to ensure a pleasant environment without risk of accidents.
  • Perform, under supervision, other activities inherent to their area of expertise.
